entries.zh-Hans: 更改立即生效，并在下次启动时保留。
entries.en: Changes apply immediately and are kept for the next launch.

entries.zh-Hans: 切换界面与提示语言，保留当前进度和未应用的卡组。
entries.en: Change the language of menus and hints. Progress and unapplied deck edits are kept.

entries.zh-Hans: 调整桌面界面的大小。引导与悬停说明保持独立阅读尺寸。
entries.en: Resize the desktop interface. Guides and tooltips keep their own reading size.

entries.zh-Hans: 设置未能保存，请检查本地配置目录是否可写。
entries.en: Could not save settings. Check that the local configuration folder is writable.

entries.zh-Hans: 顶部显示当前游历和队伍状态。拖动挂机条移动窗口，用展开按钮查看背包和其他面板；悬停按钮可查看用途。
entries.en: The top strip shows the current travel and party state. Drag it to move the window, then expand it to open your inventory and other panels. Hover over a button to learn what it does.

entries.zh-Hans: 左侧存放物品，中间查看当前角色、装备和卡组。查看角色不会改变出战编队；悬停装备或属性查看详细说明。
entries.en: Items are stored on the left. The middle panel shows the selected character, equipment and deck. Inspecting a character does not change the active party. Hover over equipment or an attribute for details.

entries.zh-Hans: 选择队伍中的位置，再从候选角色中挑选替换对象。确认后才应用编队，取消可保留原队伍。
entries.en: Select a party slot, then choose a replacement from the available characters. Confirm to apply the party, or cancel to keep the original lineup.

entries.zh-Hans: 选择角色后编辑携带卡牌。数量与解锁条件满足要求才能应用；切页和查看说明会保留未应用草稿。
entries.en: Choose a character and edit their carried cards. Apply is available when the card count and unlock requirements are met. Changing tabs or reading help keeps unapplied edits.

entries.zh-Hans: 沿四个方向选择天赋，查看前置、升级花费与下一等级效果。右侧合计属性汇总已经获得的加成。
entries.en: Choose talents along the four paths. Check prerequisites, upgrade costs and the next level's effect. The attribute summary on the right totals the bonuses you have earned.

entries.zh-Hans: 先选择工具，再放入符合要求的装备或材料。确认前检查数量、花费和成功率；不可执行时，查看按钮提示的具体原因。
entries.en: Choose a tool, then place eligible equipment or materials. Check the quantity, cost and success chance before confirming. If an action is unavailable, hover over its button to see why.

entries.zh-Hans: 选择难度、章节与已解锁关卡。挑战进入完整战斗；游历让队伍自动推进。关卡状态和当前游历分别显示。
entries.en: Select a difficulty, chapter and unlocked stage. Challenge opens a full battle; Travel lets the party advance automatically. Stage progress and the current travel are shown separately.

entries.zh-Hans: 浏览可进行任务和待领取奖励，点击图卡查看剧情与下一步条件。关闭详情会返回之前的界面。
entries.en: Browse available quests and rewards to claim. Select an illustrated card to read the story and the requirements for the next step. Close the details to return to the previous screen.

entries.zh-Hans: 选择课程查看机制、学习进度和首通奖励。重新练习保留已领奖记录，退出教程会返回原界面。
entries.en: Choose a course to see its mechanics, progress and first-clear reward. Replaying keeps the reward record. Exiting a lesson returns you to the previous screen.

entries.zh-Hans: 先选商品，再调整数量并核对总价。购买结果会单独列出；悬停装备和宝石可查看品质与属性。
entries.en: Select a product, adjust the quantity and check the total price. Purchased items appear in a results panel. Hover over equipment and gems to inspect their quality and attributes.

entries.zh-Hans: 沿可到达的节点推进，悬停图标查看节点类型与内容。已经走过的位置会保留标记；结算后返回桌面。
entries.en: Advance through reachable nodes. Hover over an icon to see its type and contents. Visited positions keep their markers. Return to the desktop after settlement.

entries.zh-Hans: 先看敌方意图，再检查共享气力与各角色内力。选择手牌和合法目标出牌；右键取消选目标，结束回合让敌方行动。
entries.en: Read enemy intents, then check shared Energy and each character's Inner Power. Play a card by selecting it and a legal target. Right-click to cancel targeting; end the turn to let enemies act.

entries.zh-Hans: 查看当前节点的选项、花费和奖励，确认后才执行对应动作。首领结算按结果发奖，返回按钮带你回到桌面工作台。
entries.en: Review this encounter's choices, costs and rewards before confirming an action. Boss settlement grants the resulting rewards, and the return button takes you back to the desktop workbench.

entries.zh-Hans: 悬停查看，Shift 详述，Ctrl 术语。
entries.en: Hover to inspect; Shift for details, Ctrl for keywords.

entries.zh-Hans: 当前区域已关闭，说明已结束。
entries.en: This area has closed, so the guide has ended.

entries.zh-Hans: 首次通关奖励：{Amount} 局外金币
开战：全队获得6气势、4蓄力。
entries.en: Battle start: the party gains 6 Momentum and 4 Charge.

entries.zh-Hans: 回合开始：全敌叠加最高攻击20%的中毒。
entries.en: Turn start: apply Poison equal to 20% of the highest party Attack to all enemies.

entries.zh-Hans: 主动牌获得护甲后，出牌者回3内力。每回合3次。
entries.en: After an active card grants Armor, its owner restores 3 Inner Power. 3 times per turn.

entries.zh-Hans: 回合开始：全队获得自身防御60%的护甲。
entries.en: Turn start: each party member gains Armor equal to 60% of their Defense.

entries.zh-Hans: 回合结束：护甲最高者获得2格挡、3气势。
entries.en: Turn end: the party member with the most Armor gains 2 Block and 3 Momentum.

entries.zh-Hans: 主动换地势后，全队回3内力并抽1牌。每回合1次。
entries.en: After actively changing terrain, restore 3 Inner Power to the party and draw 1 card. Once per turn.

entries.zh-Hans: 主动牌实际治疗后，目标获得等量护甲。每回合3次。
entries.en: After an active card restores Health, its targets gain that much Armor. 3 times per turn.

entries.zh-Hans: 主动牌实际治疗后，全队获得4药效。每回合3次。
entries.en: After an active card restores Health, the party gains 4 Medicine. 3 times per turn.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合第3张主动牌：回1气力，全队回3内力。
entries.en: On the 3rd active card each turn: gain 1 Energy and restore 3 Inner Power to the party.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首张主动牌后，出牌者获得4蓄力与自身防御50%的护甲。
entries.en: After the first active card each turn, its owner gains 4 Charge and Armor equal to 50% of their Defense.

entries.zh-Hans: 主动攻击命中流血敌人，追加自身攻击30%的伤害。每回合3次。
entries.en: An active attack hitting a bleeding enemy deals an extra 30% of its owner's Attack as damage. 3 times per turn.

entries.zh-Hans: 回合开始：全敌获得2标记，全队获得2蓄力。
entries.en: Turn start: all enemies gain 2 Mark and the party gains 2 Charge.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合前3张主动牌后，全敌叠加最高攻击10%的灼烧。
entries.en: After each of the first 3 active cards per turn, apply Burn equal to 10% of the highest party Attack to all enemies.

entries.zh-Hans: 连续由不同角色主动出牌，出牌者获得4蓄力。每回合3次。
entries.en: When a different character plays the next active card, that owner gains 4 Charge. 3 times per turn.

entries.zh-Hans: 回合开始：半血及以下队员恢复自身最大气血20%。
entries.en: Turn start: party members at half Health or below restore 20% of their maximum Health.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次主动命中标记敌人：回1气力，出牌者获3气势。
entries.en: The first active hit on a marked enemy each turn grants 1 Energy and 3 Momentum to its owner.

entries.zh-Hans: 主动毒爆结算后，出牌者回4内力并抽1牌。每回合2次。
entries.en: After an active Toxic Explosion, its owner restores 4 Inner Power and draws 1 card. Twice per turn.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次主动消耗蓄力后：返还4蓄力，回1气力。
entries.en: After the first active use of Charge each turn: regain 4 Charge and 1 Energy.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首张主动牌后抽2牌。
entries.en: Draw 2 cards after the first active card each turn.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次受到生命伤害后，受击队员获得自身防御120%的护甲。
entries.en: After the first Health damage each turn, the injured party member gains Armor equal to 120% of their Defense.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合第3张主动牌：回2气力，抽2牌。
entries.en: On the 3rd active card each turn: gain 2 Energy and draw 2 cards.

entries.zh-Hans: 每名队员每回合首次主动出牌后：抽1牌，回4内力。
entries.en: After each party member's first active card per turn: draw 1 card and restore 4 Inner Power to that owner.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合3名不同队员均主动出牌后：全队获得2格挡、回5内力。
entries.en: After 3 different party members play active cards in a turn: the party gains 2 Block and restores 5 Inner Power.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合第5张主动牌后，对全敌造成最高攻击150%的伤害。
entries.en: After the 5th active card each turn, deal 150% of the highest party Attack as damage to all enemies.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次主动换地势后：回2气力，全队获得自身防御100%的护甲。
entries.en: After the first active terrain change each turn: gain 2 Energy, and each party member gains Armor equal to 100% of their Defense.

entries.zh-Hans: 回合结束：触发全敌流血与灼烧各1次。
entries.en: Turn end: trigger Bleed and Burn on all enemies once each.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次主动治疗后：全队恢复最大气血15%，获得6药效。
entries.en: After the first active heal each turn: the party restores 15% of maximum Health and gains 6 Medicine.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次主动出牌耗尽内力：回满出牌者内力，抽2牌。
entries.en: The first active card to spend its owner's remaining Inner Power each turn refills that owner's Inner Power and draws 2 cards.

entries.zh-Hans: 回合开始：全队获得自身防御120%的护甲与1反击。
entries.en: Turn start: each party member gains Armor equal to 120% of their Defense and 1 Counter.

entries.zh-Hans: 主动命中标记敌人后，追加最高攻击60%的伤害。每回合3次。
entries.en: After an active hit on a marked enemy, deal an extra 60% of the highest party Attack as damage. 3 times per turn.

entries.zh-Hans: 战斗开始时，全队获得4点护甲。
entries.en: At battle start, the party gains 4 Armor.

entries.zh-Hans: 战斗开始时，全队恢复3点内力。
entries.en: At battle start, the party restores 3 Inner Power.

entries.zh-Hans: 战斗开始时，全队恢复8点气血。
entries.en: At battle start, the party restores 8 Health.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合开始时，主角恢复2点内力。
entries.en: At turn start, the Hero restores 2 Inner Power.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合结束时，全队获得2点护甲。
entries.en: At turn end, the party gains 2 Armor.

entries.zh-Hans: 受到伤害后，受击者获得2点护甲。
entries.en: After taking Health damage, the injured party member gains 2 Armor.

entries.zh-Hans: 受到伤害后，受击者恢复1点气血。
entries.en: After taking Health damage, the injured party member restores 1 Health.

entries.zh-Hans: 击败敌人时，全队恢复4点气血。
entries.en: When an enemy is defeated, the party restores 4 Health.

entries.zh-Hans: 击败敌人时，其余敌人获得1层流血。
entries.en: When an enemy is defeated, the remaining enemies gain 1 Bleed.

entries.zh-Hans: 击败敌人时，全队获得3点护甲。
entries.en: When an enemy is defeated, the party gains 3 Armor.

entries.zh-Hans: 旧时行旅之物，现已不再产出行旅钱。
entries.en: An old memento of the road. It no longer produces Travel Coins.

entries.zh-Hans: 完成路线节点时，主角恢复3点气血。
entries.en: After completing a route node, the Hero restores 3 Health.

entries.zh-Hans: 完成路线节点时，本路线最大气血提高2点。
entries.en: After completing a route node, maximum Health increases by 2 for this run.

entries.zh-Hans: 完成路线节点时，本路线攻击提高1点。
entries.en: After completing a route node, Attack increases by 1 for this run.

entries.zh-Hans: 完成路线节点时，本路线最大内力提高1点。
entries.en: After completing a route node, maximum Inner Power increases by 1 for this run.

entries.zh-Hans: 战斗中任一角色气血将降至50%以下时，令其至少保留1点气血，消耗此遗物并使全队恢复30%最大气血。
entries.en: When a party member would fall below 50% Health in battle, keep them at 1 Health or more, consume this relic, and restore 30% of maximum Health to the party.

entries.zh-Hans: 墨圈：本次行程已选择过的节点。淡色：暂时无法前往。悬停节点可查看说明。
entries.en: Ink circles mark nodes selected during this run. Faded nodes are not currently reachable. Hover over a node for details.
The starting point of this run.
Win the battle, then choose a reward.
Face stronger enemies for better rewards.
Defeat the boss to settle this stage.

entries.en: Upgrade cards or buy relics with Travel Coins.

entries.zh-Hans: 属性机缘 · 主线见闻
entries.en: Discover attribute bonuses and story encounters.

entries.en: Window pinned. Click to stop keeping it on top.

entries.en: Sound is on. Click to mute.

entries.en: Exit the game. You will be asked to confirm.
